## Description

Chooses portfolio weights to control conditional value at risk while allowing for uncertainty in the return distribution rather than trusting a single estimate.

## Where it may fit

Tail-risk-aware allocation, limited return-history settings or scenarios where normality assumptions are implausible.

## Vehicles

Institutional multi-asset, hedge funds, risk-managed ETF portfolios.

## Required data

Historical/scenario returns, loss confidence level, uncertainty set, constraints and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Results depend on scenario coverage and uncertainty-set design; tail estimates are unstable and may produce conservative allocations.
